metadata.title: Aditi Athreyas
metadata.description: Aditi Athreyas is a Purdue student studying Economics and Industrial Engineering, working across consulting, operations, consumer insights, and student leadership.

hero.name: Aditi Athreyas
hero.quote: Build a life that feels as intentional as it looks.
hero.intro: Hi! I'm Aditi Athreyas, currently at Purdue University, passionate about uniting the worlds of engineering and operations to lead at the forefront of innovation.
hero.blurb: I’m a student at Purdue University studying Economics and Industrial Engineering, interested in how systems, technology, and business strategy intersect.

professionalWork.title: Scope Consulting
professionalWork.body: Client-facing consulting work focused on market research, technical commercialization, and go-to-market strategy.
projectHighlights: Helped Attochron explore where its free-space optical communications technology could fit in Earth-to-Space markets.
Owned the competitor analysis workstream, comparing direct FSOC players with adjacent satellite communications and RF alternatives.
Turned research into client-ready strategy: market sizing, customer segmentation, go-to-market direction, and final presentation storytelling.

gallery.title: Attochron Final Presentation
gallery.description: Earth-to-Space use-case analysis deck covering competitor analysis, market opportunity, customer segmentation, and go-to-market recommendations.

professionalWork.title: 180 Degrees Consulting
professionalWork.body: Consulting project work focused on nonprofit strategy, student outreach, and turning research into practical recommendations.
projectHighlights: Worked with Homestead Resources on a strategy project focused on improving student engagement with financial literacy programming.
Used research and survey findings to understand awareness gaps, outreach friction, and what would make workshops feel more useful to students.
Helped shape the recommendation story into a final client deck with practical next steps for messaging and program visibility.

gallery.title: Homestead Resources Final Deck
gallery.description: A curated view of the final consulting presentation for Homestead Resources, focused on student awareness, engagement barriers, and recommended next steps.

professionalWork.title: Purdue University MARS Lab
professionalWork.body: Research work at Purdue connecting engineering systems, structured analysis, and technical communication.
projectHighlights: Supported research workflows by organizing technical information, reading across project context, and helping translate findings into clearer research materials.
Built comfort working in an engineering research environment where precision, documentation, and cross-functional communication matter.
Used the role to deepen the analytical side of my portfolio alongside consulting, operations, and creative storytelling.

professionalWork.title: Purdue Momentum
professionalWork.body: Led external engagement for a 70+ member organization and helped direct Convergence, a 120+ participant case competition.

professionalWork.title: Beats by Dre
professionalWork.body: Synthesized survey responses and competitor research into pricing, positioning, and brand recommendations.

involvements.body: Managed hospitality, liaison work, and event operations for a cultural organization built around dance and community.
Helped lead PFAS testing and sustainability outreach, including team operations, programming, and community-facing project work.
organizationContributions: Created Instagram content to make PFAS testing, clean water advocacy, and sustainability outreach easier for students and community members to understand.
Balanced operations with storytelling: team coordination, public-facing education, and simple visual messaging around environmental health.

creativeWork.title: PFAS Awareness Carousel

creativeWork.title: Blood Drive + Service Graphics

creativeWork.title: Momentum Event Storytelling
creativeWork.body: Posts and messaging for student leadership, external affairs, and case competition energy: professional, warm, and easy to scan.

paragraphs: I like work that sits between people and systems: learning what a team is trying to do, finding the bottleneck, and building the structure that helps everyone move with more confidence.
Right now, that shows up through consulting projects, student organizations, sponsorship tooling, case competitions, community work, and data-backed storytelling.
